recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the remaining source-side reciprocal link requested by FHIR-53082 without reopening the neighboring CDS documentation updates from the same PR.

That commit made the page informative, added the Definition pattern and CPG Activity Flow references, and refreshed page content, but it did not update the active Definition pattern source.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes both the Clinical Reasoning Definitional Resources page and the Workflow Definition Pattern page in the current build. The current clinical reasoning page already contains the requested status and outbound references. Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-53082 discussion or conflicting community evidence.
